title_as_printed: Experimental Solubility Data of Carbon Dioxide in Water Generated in This Work
pressure_note: Bubble-point pressure of a binary of known overall CO2 mole fraction (graphical pressure versus cell volume slope change in a variable-volume PVT cell); absolute pressure not stated explicitly.
notes: Printed in two side-by-side T/P/x column groups within three temperature-range blocks; stacked as left group first, then right group, within each block. Block labels: 273.15 K < T <= 277.13 K (rows 1-3), 277.13 K < T <= Tc (rows 5-19), Tc < T <= 373.15 K (rows 21-29); Tc = 304.2 K (Table 5 of the paper). xCO2 is the overall CO2 mole fraction of the loaded mixture at its bubble point, which the authors report as the solubility. The CSV values were printed with a thin-space digit group (0.002 62); the thin space was removed (0.00262). The first block (274.14-276.74 K) lies in the temperature range where CO2 hydrate can form (hydrate phase presence is not stated for any row); row 274.14 K/0.190 MPa is below the hydrate pressure. Not marked regime=hydrate because the paper does not say. Pressure range up to 9.3 MPa; rows above 304.2 K (Tc) are listed separately by the authors.
